Method.name: submitSingleMessage
Method.Implementation:
set status = $$$OK Set ..Adapter.WebServiceClientClass = "IHC.ITF.Service.clientPortSoap12" Set tSC = ..Adapter.InvokeMethod("submitSingleMessage",.return,pRequest.username,pRequest.password,pRequest.facilityID,pRequest.hl7Message) Set tSC = pRequest.NewResponse(.pResponse) Set pResponse.return=$get(return)
If pResponse.return["MESSAGE REJECTED"{ $$$TRACE("RESPONSE ERROR -YES") set errTxt = pResponse.return set hl7Msg = pRequest.hl7Message set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).InputDataError("Out-Iris-Vxu-Wssc", errTxt_" Hl7Message --> "_hl7Msg) } Quit status
